description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of Git configurations related to 'safe.bareRepository'. It defines test functions and executes various scenarios to verify that the configuration setting is handled correctly in different contexts.

methods.name: expect_accepted_implicit
methods.description: Verifies that the command operates successfully when the implicit safe.bareRepository configuration is set, checking the trace output for specific entries.

methods.name: expect_accepted_explicit
methods.description: Verifies that the command operates successfully with an explicit GIT_DIR, checking that certain trace entries are absent.

methods.name: expect_rejected
methods.description: Verifies that the command fails under certain configurations, and that appropriate error and trace messages are produced.
